mcp.intro: With MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI services like Claude, ChatGPT, and Codex can read and write your projects, stories, and worldbuilding directly — no more copy and paste.
mcp.needsOAuth: Requires OAuth. Set it up on steamloom.works.
mcp.oauthSteamLoomOnly: OAuth is only available on steamloom.works. The faryne.dev MCP endpoint only supports Personal Access Tokens.
mcp.patShowOnce: This token is shown only once. Paste it into your config now; you won't see it again after leaving this page.
mcp.patPending: After you create it, the token and {{service}} setup will appear here.
mcp.oauthDone: That's it once you press "Allow". You can review or revoke it on the <link>OAuth Token page</link>.
mcp.patDone: Restart the tool after setup to connect. Manage or revoke tokens on the <link>Personal Access Token page</link>.
mcp.endpointNote: MCP endpoint: {{endpoint}} · SSE isn't supported yet, which may be why a tool gets stuck connecting. Not sure how to set it up? See the official MCP docs.

oauth.description: Press "Allow" once in your browser and you're connected — no token to copy. Revoke anytime on the OAuth Token page.
